inputs.text: A handheld, continuous eye-level tracking shot following a young woman (early 20s, messy dark shoulder-length hair, wearing a dark green utility jacket and a crossbody bag) as she walks natural and leisurely through a bustling, sun-drenched outdoor street market in the late afternoon. She is looking around at the stalls, holding a small paper bag of food, and casually glances to the side and slightly back with a natural, unposed smile as she walks. The camera stays steadily with her, moving backward to capture her continuous forward motion through the crowd. In the background, busy pedestrians walk by, steam rises steadily from food stalls, and natural lens flare catching the camera as sunlight filters through rustic storefronts. Soft, handheld camera movement, cinematic natural lighting, 35mm film grain, 10-second continuous natural candid walk.
